fees.notes: Unverified: HELP University publishes only a Malaysian-student fee summary (2026 HELP University Programme Fees Summary, July 2026, 2026-09-18); no public international-student fee schedule exists. International applicants are directed to contact HELP. Previous third-party/estimated value removed.

requirements.general: Entry Requirements Applicants must meet one of the following entry requirements: SPM/SPMV/MCE: Minimum of three (3) credits Other equivalent qualifications: As approved by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA) Candidates without SPM/MCE: Must follow an alternative pathway approved by MQA, which includes: Qualifying test on Bahasa Melayu, English, and Mathematics (APEL Route by MQA) English Requirement (International Students) IELTS: Band 4 MUET: Band 2
